title: Add content_document_file() and content_document_url() for text/CSV/code files
description: chatlas PR #345 added content_document_file(), content_document_url(), and related helpers so users can pass text, Markdown, CSV, or code files to a chat the same way they pass images or PDFs, preserving provider-side metadata. ellmer's NAMESPACE exports content_pdf_file() and content_image_file() but has no equivalent content_document_* functions, and neither NEWS.md nor any open ellmer issue/PR covers this.

title: Fail loudly when a built-in tool isn't supported by the provider
description: chatlas PR #370 made providers that don't support built-in tools like tool_web_search() raise a clear error instead of silently passing an empty tool definition. ellmer's NEWS and open PRs don't mention a comparable guard for providers that receive unsupported built-in tools.

title: Consolidate multiple tool results into a single block per tool call
description: chatlas PR #363 fixed a bug where MCP servers returning rich tool results (multiple chunks or image plus text) caused API errors because providers expect exactly one result block per tool-use ID. ellmer's NEWS and open PRs don't describe an equivalent fix for multi-content tool results.

title: Provider files API (upload once, reference by ID)
description: chatlas PR #334 added a provider-level file upload API so large files can be sent once and referenced by ID in subsequent turns, reducing repeated bandwidth and token costs. ellmer exports claude_file_* functions for Anthropic but has no general provider files API; neither NEWS nor open PRs describe an equivalent cross-provider file upload mechanism.
